tasks.title: Establish .NET modernization baseline
tasks.description: Upgrade the current .NET Framework service baseline to a supported modernization-ready runtime and align project/dependencies for Azure migration execution.

validation.expected: Application builds and tests pass on a supported agent/runtime for the selected target

requirements: Define and apply target runtime/framework baseline for modernization
Update incompatible dependencies required by the selected baseline
Ensure downstream modernization tasks can depend on this upgraded baseline

tasks.title: Remediate security vulnerabilities and harden dependencies
tasks.description: Perform security/CVE remediation for runtime and package dependencies and validate no critical/high vulnerabilities remain before deployment.
tasks.target: Application dependency and runtime security posture

validation.expected: No open critical/high CVEs and remediation evidence recorded

requirements: Identify and remediate critical/high CVEs in runtime and dependencies
Document residual risks and required compensating controls where applicable
Establish repeatable vulnerability scan and validation gate

tasks.title: Deploy service to Azure Container Apps
tasks.description: Containerize and deploy the modernized service to Azure Container Apps as the default deployment target with smoke-test validation.

validation.expected: Service is deployed and health/smoke checks pass in Azure environment

requirements: Package service for Azure Container Apps deployment
Configure environment settings and secrets securely
Execute post-deployment smoke tests and verify service health
